subject: Approval needed: Security-conditioned trial allocation for on-prem VPC POC
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@veridianhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Arun Kapur <arun.kapur@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — private VPC evaluation & compliance gating

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're preparing a limited on-prem/VPC POC to evaluate Redwood against our security controls. Two asks from our side before we can commit time:

1) A time-limited trial allocation (credits) so our infra team can run sustained load without immediate cost blockers.
2) A short list of compliance evidence we can expect to see (SOC2 artifacts, pen-test summary, KMS/Key custody details, audit log retention).

Can Redwood provide a conditional credit package tied to delivery of specific compliance items? We're targeting a 60–90 day POC and need to present a cost-neutral plan to procurement.

I've attached our internal questionnaire to show the scope. Happy to jump on a short call.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Security, Veridian Health
(Attachment: veridian_security_questionnaire.pdf)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Arun Kapur <arun.kapur@veridianhealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — private VPC evaluation & compliance gating

Hi Elena — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear asks. We can support a security-conditioned allocation for a VPC/on-prem POC; need to coordinate internally on the size and exact gating.

High level proposal (subject to approvals):
- Conditional trial allocation: $3,000 in platform credits, valid for 90 days.
- Conditions to release: completed security questionnaire, current pen-test summary (or plan & timeline), and a signed data processing addendum + short MSA addendum covering on-prem deployment.
- Acceptance: verification call + checklist sign-off by Veridian security after dry-run.

I'll loop in Aditya and Marissa to confirm the numbers and get finance/legal sign-off. Can you confirm the desired start week (earliest we can enable infra is Sep 6) and whether you require an air-gapped/fully offline option?

—Naomi
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot request — proposed conditional allocation for Veridian (DL-2026-7789)

Thanks Naomi — putting numbers against this so we can get quick approval:

- Proposed credit: $3,000 platform credit (covers reserved capacity bursts + API usage).
- Timebox: 90 days from activation.
- Conditions to claim credits:
  * Completed and returned questionnaire (we have Veridian's draft).
  * Pen-test summary (last 12 months) OR signed schedule for an imminent pen-test with attestation once finished.
  * KMS/HSM approach documented (who holds keys, egress controls).
  * Signed addendum (DPA + on-prem rider).

Operational asks for our enablement team: 1) access window for a 2-hour onboarding test; 2) contact for infra lead (Elena suggested Arun).

If Legal is OK with the conditional language (credits revoked if conditions unmet), Finance need to confirm cap and account for promo. Marcus — can we approve this promo as a one-off under DL-2026-7789? We should also confirm if we require a monthly invoicing holdback.

-Aditya
Senior Account Executive
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot request — proposed conditional allocation for Veridian (finance check)

Aditya — OK to approve $3k in credits with these controls, subject to:
- Credits applied as a one-time account debit over the activation window; unused credits expire.
- Legal to draft an addendum that includes a clause allowing reversal of credits if evidence is not provided within 45 days of activation.
- Limit: single payout; no stacking with other promos.

Please have Legal/AE finalize the language and I can push the credit once we get the signed DPA-addendum.

-Marcus
Head of Revenue Ops
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot request — private VPC evaluation & compliance gating

Hi Elena — good news: finance has approved a conditional $3,000 trial allocation for Veridian's VPC POC. Next steps and conditions (summary):

1) Sign the DPA + on-prem rider (we've attached a short addendum draft and SOW). DocuSign link will be sent once Legal finalizes wording.
2) Provide either: (a) pen-test summary from last 12 months, or (b) signed attestation with a scheduled pen-test within 30 days and a commitment to share the report within 45 days of activation.
3) Confirm KMS approach (who retains keys) and expected audit log retention window (we typically retain token-level logs 90 days by default; longer windows can be discussed).
4) Activation window: we can target Sep 6 for enabling the isolated VPC sandbox; credits valid for 90 days from that date.

Attachments: SOW draft (sow-vpc-poc-draft.docx) and a small checklist for the security gating. I'll follow up with Legal on DocuSign and post the HubSpot deal link for tracking.

If these terms sound good, please reply with confirmation (and attach the pen-test summary if available) and we'll queue the enablement slot.

Regards,
Naomi
From: Arun Kapur <arun.kapur@veridianhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@syssec.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — private VPC evaluation & compliance gating

Naomi / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear terms. Veridian accepts the conditional allocation. We have attached the most recent pen-test summary (pen-test-summary-2025.txt) and updated the questionnaire.

Confirmed: activation week of Sep 6 is fine; Arun (infra) will be primary contact for onboarding. We will also sign the DPA-addendum once we receive the DocuSign link.

Two quick clarifications:
- For the KMS note: we will retain customer-managed keys (KMS) and will need a config guide for integrating our HSM with the VPC runtime.
- Audit logs: we request a 180-day retention window for token-level routing logs for this POC. Let us know if that's possible and any cost implications.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Arun Kapur
Sr. Engineering Manager, Infrastructure — Veridian Health
(Attachment: pen-test-summary-2025.txt)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Arun Kapur <arun.kapur@veridianhealth.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — private VPC evaluation & compliance gating

Perfect — thanks Arun (and Rajiv) for the pen-test doc and acceptance. Quick notes:
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys; I'll loop in enablement to send the HSM integration guide before Sep 6.
- Audit logs: 180-day retention is possible as a paid add-on; Marcus, could you confirm any billing delta?

I'll open the HubSpot deal (DL-2026-7789) and upload the questionnaire and SOW draft to the shared Drive folder. DocuSign link for the DPA-addendum will follow from Legal later today. See attached SOW draft for scope/assumptions.

Talk soon — Naomi
(Attachment: sow-vpc-poc-draft.docx)
